first] faint 1824, TL (GM); slant Reiman (2002). The word is written over soft in Box 1.
 trees;] trees Box 1.
 ceaseless] In Box 1 S. wrote ceaseless then cancelled it and wrote opiate above. He then reinstated
ceaseless with an underlining, but left opiate uncancelled.
 S. could be describing a meteorological phenomenon, which normally occurs in cool morn-
ings in autumn, whereby a mist rises from a warm lake. Here, at evening, the mist then plays in the
breeze across the view of the moon, unlike the eagle, which traditionally flies towards the sun.
